Scope.finish removes the still-live request handle from Drop state, reads this independent observation before Finish consumes the request, then transfers old WireStats and the separately captured Option. Scope Drop queries replay_failed, copies live MC stats, then Abort consumes/restores TLS and old wireStats; the MC observation contains no LLVM owner or borrowed result. It does not read last-test TLS to produce a production receipt.

Existing CPP copyStats separately saves the same current MC scalars into test-only last TLS. finishMachine adds original MIR publication/capture accounting but does not mutate emissionStats, so the live snapshot precedes destruction without losing current MC capture/replay counters. Test-only last getter remains a separate check, not the source of production observations.
